Madras High Court reserves verdict on CM Stalin's election plea

The Madras High Court has reserved its order on a plea filed by Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin concerning his election from the Kolathur constituency. The court, presided over by Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan, allowed Stalin to withdraw a separate writ petition challenging Election Commission of India (ECI) standard operating procedures for EVM verification. The primary plea under consideration relates to allegations of EVM tampering.
